prose.title: Distribute values among five buckets, sort each bucket, and concatenate them in order

context: The input is nums = [0.49, 0.96, 0.82, 0.09, 0.57, 0.43, 0.91, 0.75, 0.15, 0.37]. All elements are floating-point numbers in [0, 1). The algorithm uses five buckets, each of width 0.2.
description: First place each number in the interval that contains it, including the left endpoint and excluding the right. Then sort the elements within each bucket. The five buckets in the middle of the figure show both operations complete. They do not show the original insertion order.

Finally, concatenate the buckets from the lowest range to the highest. Because their ranges do not overlap and each bucket is already sorted in ascending order, this produces the complete sorted array.
